CSS parser-color 0.5.0, crates.io archive SHA256 bbaa233e1dcd9c13a5d3e3a8a2c0f5a727bac380398345dbcb31db4597edc86b. Original MPL2.0 license retained. Local change adds FromParsedColor.from_float_rgba and preserves fractional validated RGB channels until the consumer quantizes the initial color-input value. Existing default output still follows upstream quantization. No grammar or token validity rule is duplicated. Native color validator supplies the actual Color4 conversion output. Repository tests exercise original Chromium state rather than treating upstream permissive parsing as authority.

The second local hook accepts number-or-percentage channels only in modern HSL/HWB syntax, as the pinned Chromium parser does. Legacy comma HSL keeps its percentage-only rule. Existing cssparser tokenization remains the grammar authority; typed scalar calculations come from the repository shared CssMathValidator.
